sn42.2:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn42.2:1.2: atha kho tālaputto naṭagāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho tālaputto naṭagāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.2:1.3: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.2:1.4: yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.2:1.6: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.2:1.7: dutiyampi kho tālaputto naṭagāmaṇī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn42.2:1.8: sutammetaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ

sn42.2:1.13: sutammetaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ

sn42.2:2.5: pubbe kho gāmaṇi sattā avītarāgā rāgabandhanabandhā
sn42.2:2.6: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā rajaniyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyo sarāgāya.
sn42.2:2.7: pubbe kho gāmaṇi sattā avītadosā dosabandhanabandhā
sn42.2:2.8: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā dosaniyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyo sadosāya.
sn42.2:2.9: pubbe kho gāmaṇi sattā avītamohā mohabandhanabandhā
sn42.2:2.10: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā mohaniyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyo samohāya.
sn42.2:2.11: so attanā matto pamatto pamāde ṭhatvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pahāso nāma nirayo tattha upapajjati.
sn42.2:2.12: sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti
sn42.2:2.13: yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti. sāssa ca hoti micchādiṭṭhi
sn42.2:2.14: micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi
sn42.2:3.1: evaṃ vutte tālaputto naṭagāmaṇī parodi assūni pavattesi.
sn42.2:3.3: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.2:3.4: nāhaṃ bhante etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha.
sn42.2:3.5: api cāhaṃ bhante pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi naṭehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paluddho
sn42.2:3.6: yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.2:3.8: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn42.2:3.9: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn42.2:3.10: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn42.2:3.11: alattha kho tālaputto naṭagāmaṇī bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ.
